data.desc: Healthcare Triangle, Inc. (Nasdaq: HCTI), based in Pleasanton, California, reinforces healthcare progress through breakthrough technology and extensive industry knowledge and expertise. Healthcare Triangle supports healthcare organizations - including hospitals and health systems, payers, and pharma/life sciences organizations - in their effort to improve health outcomes through better utilization of the data and information technologies they rely on. Healthcare Triangle's Cloud and Data Platform (CaDP), marketed as CloudEz and DataEz, has achieved HITRUST Risk-based, 2-year (r2) Certified status, demonstrating to clients the highest standards for data protection and information security.
